reading.action: Drop Cold Revenge (now unarmed, both bars down), reach both hands toward the wedged Sentinel and PULL all-in — a full committed Ember Siphon for the whole feast of its heat.

partA_siphon_allin.note: NAT 20 / CRIT on the all-in siphon — breakthrough band. Crit control lets him tear out a TORRENT and master the inflow (so the feast doesn't immolate him); guts the ember-core that animates the stone.

reading.result: CRIT — DECISIVE DRAIN. He tears a torrent of heat out of the Sentinel and bleeds its core cold: the ember-glow collapses, the cracks gutter dark across its whole body, the stone-slag bulk loses the fire that held it animate and grinds to a DEAD stop, slumping inert in the stairmouth. GUARDIAN FELLED — he invented and critically executed the kill method (siphon the furnace cold). ABSORPTION (a major DRAW, not a trickle): Ember Manipulation 4 -> 6 (+2, draw value). SKILL: the crit all-in siphon is an unquestionable qualifying demo -> Ember Siphon PROMOTES Novice 3 -> APPRENTICE 1 (reset to 1 on promotion; rung skillBonus now +1). XP: milestone guardian kill +200 -> LEVEL UP 3 -> 4 (xp 10/250 carryover; +3 attribute points, UNSPENT — he allocates; ties to the tempering arc, e.g. VITALITY). SELF-HARM: crit control protects him — only an edge-scald from the sheer volume, HP 42 -> 34 (-8). He now HOLDS a guardian's worth of ember, master-controlled but at his absolute ceiling — a resource AND a bomb. COST: Focus 72 -> 54 (-18 massive pull), Stamina 41 -> 37 (-4). UNARMED (equip reconcile: wielded = none; Cold Revenge dropped at his feet in the stair, Burning Anger still up at the lip). The dead cold hulk lies before him; its drained remains + the way up beyond are NEWLY REACHABLE-BUT-UNCOLLECTED (do not auto-loot/advance). STOP at his decision point — supercharged, hurt, +3 points to place, the floor's path open; his move. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
